verbs.name: shape.update
verbs.description: Edit a PLACED shape overlay clip's properties (shape kind, label text, color, geometry, …) IN PLACE — the edit companion to edit.add_shape (which only ADDS). Selecting a shape clip used to give a generic 'Video clip' inspector with no way to change it. Shapes and titles both live on `title*` overlay tracks; this recovers the originating edit.add_shape spec from the op-log (the robust shape-vs-title distinction: a shape clip has an edit.add_shape creating op, a title clip a title.add one — a title clip is refused, use title.update), merges the provided overrides (`label`/`color` are the common cases; any edit.add_shape field — shape/fill/stroke/stroke_px/opacity/radius_px/head_px/font_px/animation/x/y/w/h/x2/y2 — may also be overridden), RE-RENDERS a fresh transparent overlay .mov at the SAME duration via the SAME render path edit.add_shape uses, and swaps the clip onto the new asset. The clip id, timeline range, track, and position are all kept; only its pixels change. Committed as ONE lowered op (the asset swap; the new .mov's media.import rides ahead of it) so undo reverts the whole edit and replay re-imports + re-swaps. NOTE: `label` is the public name for the centered label text (edit.add_shape calls it `text`); `range_ms` is NOT editable here (the re-render keeps the same duration).

clip.description: Shape clip id (a clip on a 'title*' overlay track created by edit.add_shape, from project.state — it carries the shape_kind annotation)

label.description: New centered label text (the common edit; maps to edit.add_shape's `text`)

stroke.description: Override the stroke/border color #RRGGBB (rect/ellipse) or the line color (line/arrow)

stroke_px.description: Override the stroke/line width in px

radius_px.description: Override the rect corner radius in px

head_px.description: Override the arrowhead length in px (arrow)

font_px.description: Override the label font size in px

x.description: Override box left (rect/ellipse) OR start point x (line/arrow), normalized [0,1]

y.description: Override box top (rect/ellipse) OR start point y (line/arrow), normalized [0,1]

group_id.description: Internal composite-action identity used by native Motion reimports so all changed objects undo as one user action.

verbs.result: {clip, track, asset_id, shape, label}; one lowered op appended (re-renders the overlay + swaps the clip's asset in place)
